name: Black Beard Algae
description: Dark red/black tufts (BBA, Audouinella — a red alga) on hardscape and slow plant edges. Hobby consensus: thrives in strong flow with unstable / low CO2; tolerates lower light than green algae, so its light dependence is modest. growthRate / lightDependence are MODELLED tuning weights, not measured rates.
notes: True SAE are the only common fish that reliably eat it, and only when young. Mature BBA is grazer-resistant — spot-treat with liquid carbon / Excel and stabilize CO2 + flow.
